title: You got this - Ruby
style: Upbeat MANDARIN fun pop song with light hip-hop energy, performed by a confident happy 14-year-old girl named Ruby with youthful energetic vocals, bright catchy chorus, playful positive vibes only, empowering self-expression, family pride, clever genes vs jeans pun, maths nerd meets fashion girl energy. Bright synths, bouncy drums, claps, fun bass. No swearing, no aggression, wholesome and joyful. Use structure tags.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yo, it’s Ruby,
Ruby the Gem 
Ruby roo roo roo
Kanga bell bottom
Bounce bounce
 and I’m keeping it light
Good genes in my DNA, 
good jeans on my legs tonight

[Verse 1]
I only wear what feels right, what makes me smile
Not following trends, just my own style
My mum and my dad gave me more than a name
They gave me good genes and I’m proud of the same
It’s all maths to me, I see patterns everywhere
Probability, genetics, it’s all numbers in the air
But when it comes to what I wear, I keep it simple and true
Good jeans, good vibes, that’s the Ruby crew

[Pre-Chorus]
Ruby roo roo roo
Kanga bell bottom
Bounce bounce
 and I’m keeping it light

Light blue for sunny days when I’m feeling bright
Dark blue when I wanna chill and keep it low-key at night
Ripped for when I’m active, straight when I want clean
But nothing beats the ones that make me feel like a queen

[Chorus]
I only wear good jeans
Like my mum and dad got good genes
It’s all maths to me
Good genes and jeans for me!
I got light blue, dark blue, ripped and straight
Bell bottom Jeans! Bell bottom Jeans for me!

[Verse 2]
Bell bottoms swinging when I walk down the street
Retro and bold, got that extra beat
Some people laugh ‘cause I mix maths with my clothes
But I think it’s genius — that’s just how my brain goes
My genes make me curious, make me ask “why?”
My jeans make me dance, make me reach for the sky
I don’t need to copy anyone, I’m building my own lane
Good genes + good jeans = I’m winning every day

[Bridge]
Add it up, multiply the fun
Good genes and good jeans, yeah I already won
Whether they’re faded or brand new
I rock what I rock and I stay true
Maths teaches me balance, jeans teach me to play
Together they remind me I can be any way

[Chorus]
I only wear good jeans (good jeans!)
Like my mum and dad got good genes (good genes!)
It’s all maths to me (maths to me!)
Good genes and jeans for me! (for me!)
I got light blue, dark blue, ripped and straight (so many ways!)
Bell bottom Jeans! Bell bottom Jeans for me! (for me!)

[Outro]
Ruby in her good jeans, feeling so free
Good genes from my family lighting up the real me
Bell bottom or straight, I choose what feels right
Good genes and good jeans… that’s my DNA tonight!

Ruby roo roo roo
Kanga bell bottom
Bounce bounce bouce
Denim for Ruby, evey ounce!
